title: 'Send to their app' says 'Sent' even when the member will never get it
what: On Collect payment, the desk can press 'Send to their app' for any member. It always answers 'Sent. They see it under My membership in the MettleUp app.' But the please-pay pop-up only reaches a member whose mobile on the gym list matches the number they joined the app with, who has not left, whose number no other active member shares, and whose phone gave a push address. For everyone else nothing arrives, and the desk waits for money that is never asked for. At Crispy Curves only 1 of 2 members has an app check-in number and 0 of 2 are linked to the app, so at least one member gets nothing while the desk is told it was sent.
expected: Before or after sending, the sheet says whether this member is on the app and can get the pop-up; if not, it offers the QR or a WhatsApp link instead of saying 'Sent'.
how_often: every time the member is not on the app
fix_line: Show on the sheet whether this member can get the app pop-up, and only say 'Sent' when they can

title: The 'please pay' pop-up stays in the member's inbox after the desk took the money
what: When the desk sends a payment ask to the member's app, a note 'Your gym asked you to pay ... Tap to pay in the app' is written once and sent as a pop-up. When the desk later takes cash for the same due, the ask is closed, but the note is never taken back or marked done, so the member can still see an old request to pay a fee they already paid.
expected: Once the due is paid or the ask is closed, the note is removed or changed to say it is paid.
how_often: when the desk takes cash after an app ask
fix_line: Clear or update the please-pay note when the ask is closed or paid

title: Changing a member's mobile number never warns that their app pop-ups will stop
what: The mobile box says it is used to find the member and send WhatsApp messages. It does not say that the app's pop-ups (please-pay asks, new workout or diet plan, measurements) find the member by this number too. When the desk edits the number of a member who is on the app, or types a number different from the one they joined with, the save goes through without a word and those pop-ups quietly stop reaching them.
expected: The hint says the number must match the one the member uses in the app, and editing the number of a member on the app warns that their pop-ups will stop until it matches.
how_often: whenever a number is edited or typed differently
fix_line: Warn on the form when the number does not match the member's app number

title: Add member never says the birthday wish needs a date of birth
what: Date of birth is an optional box with no hint. The automatic birthday wish and the Today birthday list only reach members who have one, so a member added without it silently never gets a wish while the birthday switch says on. At Crispy Curves 1 of 2 members has a date of birth, so the wish can reach at most 1 of 2.
expected: The box says 'Needed for the birthday wish', and the owner can see which members have no birthday saved.
how_often: every member added without a birthday
fix_line: Add a hint under the birthday box and a 'no birthday saved' count for the owner

items.reason: cannot be proven in the cloud, needs a real-phone check: on an OPPO/Xiaomi/Samsung phone with battery saver on and screen off, press Send to their app for that member and look for the please-pay pop-up, its sound, and that tapping it opens the pay screen
